items.title: Execution-realism and prospective microstructure evidence
items.block_reason: Confirmed evidence-path defect: research_microstructure_veto expects forecast-time microstructure fields, but current opportunity/prediction-ledger persistence stores preforecast market-consensus provenance only. Reopen only after genuinely prospective, timestamp-defensible microstructure/execution fields are persisted with each eligible forecast and exposed to resolved research rows with deterministic regression coverage.
items.goal: Measure whether timestamp-safe public Kraken spread, visible depth, direction-aware imbalance, liquidity deterioration, microprice deviation, and size-aware expected slippage identify conditions where otherwise-valid signals lose incremental after-cost value. Keep 24h and 7d economics separate and require a sufficiently sampled normal-execution baseline before attributing losses to execution. Do not retry or rescue the rejected DATA-BASIS-001 or DATA-FUNDING-001 fingerprints, and do not re-probe unchanged blocked historical-OI routes unless access conditions materially change.
acceptance: research uses genuinely timestamped public microstructure data and remains research-only
forecast-time microstructure/execution evidence is durably persisted and exposed to resolved research rows without historical reconstruction or backfill
suspected adverse execution conditions are compared with a sufficiently sampled normal-execution baseline
24h and 7d execution economics are evaluated separately
new evidence is timestamp-safe and stale, future, crossed, malformed, or one-sided books fail closed
incremental after-cost value includes realistic fees, spread, slippage, missed-fill/adverse-selection assumptions, and cost stress
rejected DATA-BASIS-001 and DATA-FUNDING-001 fingerprints are not tuned, rescued, or reintroduced under a new name
unchanged blocked historical-OI routes are not retried without materially changed access conditions
research-only features cannot authorize live trades, paper-authority changes, broker connectivity, or promotion
deterministic regression tests pass
